subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers adopt a narrow custom-prompt guard in `src/infra/heartbeat-runner.ts`, or wait for a broader heartbeat transcript/runtime-context cleanup before fixing this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but existing routing labels and related conflicting PRs indicate maintainers should choose the adoption path before ClawSweeper creates another fix branch.

options.title: Adopt the narrow guard
options.body: Guard workspace-path/directive injection so it only applies to built-in/internal heartbeat prompts, then add focused regression tests for configured prompts containing HEARTBEAT.md.

options.title: Fold into broader heartbeat runtime work
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-owned heartbeat transcript/runtime-context PR explicitly covers custom prompt preservation and ships proof.

options.title: Change the documented contract
options.body: If maintainers want OpenClaw to mutate configured prompts, update the docs and issue rationale, but that would be a user-visible contract change.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow guard
recommendation.body: Guard workspace-path/directive injection so it only applies to built-in/internal heartbeat prompts, then add focused regression tests for configured prompts containing HEARTBEAT.md.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle appears in recent heartbeat runner/docs history and is the best current routing candidate for choosing between narrow repair and broader heartbeat cleanup.
